python -c "
import json, sys, datetime, pathlib, re, os

data = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
saved_file = data.get('file', data.get('path', ''))
ws = r'E:\Rajkumar\Bridge_GAD_Yogendra_Borse'
creat = pathlib.Path(ws) / 'CREAT.MD'

if not creat.exists():
    sys.exit(0)

# Skip self-updates (saving CREAT.MD would loop)
if pathlib.Path(saved_file).name == 'CREAT.MD':
    sys.exit(0)

rel = pathlib.Path(saved_file).relative_to(ws) if saved_file.startswith(ws) else pathlib.Path(saved_file).name
ts = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M IST')
entry = f'\n### [{ts}] File saved: {rel}\n\n'

content = creat.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
marker = '## SESSION LOG'
if marker in content:
    idx = content.index(marker) + len(marker)
    # Find end of the marker line
    nl = content.index('\n', idx)
    comment_end = content.index('\n', content.index('\n', nl+1)+1) if '<!-- ' in content[nl:nl+200] else nl
    insert_at = comment_end + 1
    new_content = content[:insert_at] + entry + content[insert_at:]
    creat.write_text(new_content, encoding='utf-8')
sys.exit(0)
"
